verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows a narrow bulk capability (creating up to 250 shipping labels at once) and general Admin/GraphQL APIs for building integrations, but there is no documentation of a general-purpose bulk operations API (e.g., bulk query/mutation across arbitrary resources) that an AI agent could invoke to operate on many items at once across the platform. Missing for 10: explicit bulk operations/GraphQL bulk API documentation, evidence of AI/agent-driven bulk actions beyond shipping labels, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale reliability.
